title: Abandoned radar base found near Alvado
place_text: Mountain peak near Alvado, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Well, we dug into that 1999. We came out looking for radar bases. Looked every high peak in this area all the way over towards Santa Fe. We found the one in Alvado and we hiked up there in about 2 ft of snow and there it was just like they left it in 1957.

plain: An old radar base still sits on a mountain peak near Alvado, New Mexico, "just like they left it in 1957", according to a crash-site researcher named Scott Ramsey. He tells Michels that in 1999 his team searched every high peak in the area, out toward Santa Fe, for old radar bases, found this one, and hiked up to it through about two feet of snow. He tells it as part of his search for evidence of a crash he believes happened in that region, since radar there could have tracked whatever came down.
